description: This file is a shell script for testing git submodule diff behavior when submodules are not initialized. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and checks related to git submodules, including adding, removing, updating, and moving submodules.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds specified files to a git repository, commits them with a message indicating the added files, and outputs the commit hash.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message indicating the files committed.
